title: Morning Brief
summary: The founders agreed to launch Haskap as soon as possible on a modest budget, with a new business manager, pixel and ad account bought during the call, and to move Avia to Shopify with Skio for retention. They want to judge pricing on LTV to CAC, preferring scale at 0.4 over 0.9, and test a lower front-end price with monthly rebilling. Late Avia Black Friday statics, a 58.99 price set instead of 59.99, and scheduled automations that stopped refreshing Founder OS and weekly pacing put creative throughput and quality control at the top of the list.
points: Jelly sticks look like an early, durable format; a simple cortisol formula with ashwagandha, L-theanine, saffron, lemon balm and rhodiola was discussed
Lower front-end pricing with monthly rebilling could improve retention over upsell-heavy first orders
Avia move to Shopify, Skio and related retention tools, with upsells moved after the sale
Haskap could run on Shopify alongside MAIA; a broader super cacao formula is under consideration
The general Avia campaign spent about 500 without results and Black Friday and Cyber Monday statics were not added
Creative throughput, editor oversight and activity and credit reporting are the main operational priorities; two strategists start Monday
Scheduled automations, Founder OS call imports, weekly pacing and the cash flow sheet are not refreshing reliably
decisions: Launch Haskap as soon as possible with modest initial spend
Use a new business manager and ad account for Haskap, with the pixel under the current funnel
Move Avia to Shopify with Skio for retention
Judge pricing and scaling on LTV to CAC rather than front-end ROAS
Increase creative briefs and editor oversight and replace underperforming contributors
